description:
git::sync::tests::migrate_store_ref_to_v2_dry_run_peeks_remote_without_mutating_tracking_ref fails at crates/kopi-beans/src/git/sync.rs:3279.

  assertion `left == right` failed
    left: OrSetV1
   right: LegacyEdges

PRE-EXISTING, not caused by the network-push change in f06e642 -- verified by stashing that change and re-running on a clean tree at 77410f2, where it fails identically. Rest of the git suite is green (130 passed, 1 failed, 4 ignored).

The test builds its own temp local/remote repos and writes a legacy-edges store commit, then asserts the dry run reports deps_format_before == LegacyEdges. It observes OrSetV1 instead, i.e. the dry run is reading a deps format that has already been converted. Worth checking whether write_store_commit_with_custom_deps is actually producing legacy edges, or whether migrate_store_ref_to_v2's peek path normalises before reporting.

Found while fixing the gix push gate.
title: gix_compat: migrate_store_ref_to_v2 dry-run test fails (OrSetV1 vs LegacyEdges)
